resources.string: After KernelSU is verified, run its native userspace soft reboot so modules, Zygisk, and LSPosed start in the normal lifecycle order.
Starting KernelSU soft reboot after root
Root succeeded, but KernelSU soft reboot did not start: %1$s
Use these only after KernelSU is active. Start with the lightest action that matches the problem.
Recreates only Zygote and system_server. Useful as a lightweight diagnostic; on ZZI4 prefer KernelSU soft reboot when Zygisk or LSPosed did not attach.
Re-runs KernelSU late-load module stages with the installed ksud. Use when module scripts, system properties, or metamodule mounts did not apply.
Runs KernelSU\'s native userspace restart and full module lifecycle. Preferred on ZZI4 when Zygisk or LSPosed needs a clean DEFEX-compatible startup.
Performs a full device reboot and clears the temporary KernelSU session. Auto Root is disabled first so the phone stays unrooted.
Hold an action for 1.4 seconds to run it.
KernelSU must be active before these actions can run.
Reboot & unroot disables Auto Root before reboot. Re-enable Auto Root later if you want root restored automatically.
